meta.policy: Append-only. Corrections are new entries that reference the original entry; published entries are not silently rewritten or removed.

entries.title: All-conference and all-team accountability ledgers
entries.summary: Extended private tracking to every observed CFB and CBB conference and team. The data now separates intra-conference games, occasions when THI favored or opposed a conference or team, totals performance, forecast MAE and signed bias, CLV, beat-close rate, Wilson intervals and sample warnings.
entries.impact: Audit metadata only. Nothing is added to the public interface, and these descriptive slices do not change ratings, projections, signals, grades or historical results.

entries.title: Prospective matchup-segment accountability ledgers
entries.summary: Added data-only CFB P4-vs-P4 and G6-vs-G6 plus CBB P5-vs-P5 and Mid-Major-vs-Mid-Major tracking. Each ledger preserves all spreads, 2.5-plus and 5-plus disagreements, four-plus total disagreements, CLV coverage, beat-close rate, Wilson intervals, sample warnings, and weekly and monthly splits.
entries.impact: Audit metadata and reporting only. The segment ledgers are not rendered in the public UI and do not change projections, ratings, market selection, signal labels, grades or historical results.

entries.title: Relative Market Fit and prospective moneyline contract
entries.summary: Added descriptive spread-versus-moneyline comparison using two-sided sportsbook prices, no-vig probabilities, a minimum three-percentage-point model edge, at least two complete moneyline books, favorite prices from -100 through -185, and model-favored underdogs or pick'ems from +100 through +250. New qualifying moneyline observations are frozen prospectively in a ledger separate from ATS.
entries.impact: Market comparison and prospective tracking contract only. No rating, projected score, spread, total, win probability, model input, ATS result or historical record changed; no old moneyline result is backfilled.

entries.title: Overall accountability replaces promoted tier scorekeeping
entries.summary: Removed public Play Tier and Notable Tier record emphasis. Model Tracking now leads with overall SU, ATS, totals, CLV and beat-close results, while descriptive disagreement labels remain available on matchup research surfaces.
entries.impact: Presentation only. Existing frozen decisions, grades, exclusions and historical records were not rewritten.

entries.title: Public Research Workbench and verifier packet
entries.summary: Added a searchable frozen forecast archive, historical team comparison, date and venue filters, existing season-outlook access, honest roster and lineup coverage disclosures, filtered CSV export, a public research cadence registry, and independent-verification JSON/CSV packets.
entries.impact: Research workflow, audit distribution and presentation only. No projection, rating, probability, signal, grade, model weight or historical result changed.

entries.title: Benchmark Center uncertainty and governance release
entries.summary: Added precomputed 95% Wilson and fixed-seed bootstrap intervals, Forecasting versus Market Translation views, source coverage, distinct result and CLV samples, CSV metadata, and small-sample warnings.
entries.impact: Presentation and audit metadata only. No projection, grade, signal, model weight, historical result or promotion status changed.

entries.title: Existing CFB and CBB market rules documented publicly
entries.summary: Published the existing CFB executable-quote safeguards and closing-proxy window, plus CBB median consensus, half-point grading and first-capture opening rules.
entries.impact: Documentation and version registration only. This entry did not retroactively change line selection or grading.

entries.title: Public version registry initialized
entries.summary: Registered the already-operating CFB production version production-model-a-2026-week1-freeze-v1 and CBB research version thi-cbb-walk-forward-v0.6-research in the public audit contract.
entries.impact: Registry initialization, not a model change. CFB remains production; CBB remains research.

entries.title: Prospective CBB projection timestamps enabled
entries.summary: Newly generated scheduled-game projections now carry their actual generated-at timestamp, which remains attached when the game settles.
entries.impact: Prospective archive hardening only. Historical missing timestamps are labeled not archived and are not reconstructed.
